summary: This pass addresses reading order, receipt clarity and text enlargement. The adopted pricing formula and historical source corpus are unchanged.

The final billing interaction is one receipt. Membership and editable usage lead to subtotal and rounding, then an optional donation and final total. Supporting calculations and background come afterward.
These are bounded engineering and editorial observations, not proof that every visitor will understand the site or a formal accessibility certification.
method: 28 existing Node regression tests plus 18 observed browser procedures. The browser checks were performed through direct cloud-Chrome interaction; they are not an unattended test suite.

Desktop screenshots and narrow same-origin frames were inspected. Root-font enlargement to 200% and a narrow viewport displayed at 2x tested two distinct kinds of reflow. Native browser zoom, physical Safari/iPhone, VoiceOver and denied-clipboard paths remain unverified.
The temporary responsive fixture is excluded from the release. Screenshots in this review show the local production-source preview. The deployed revision receives an additional public smoke check.

Uber reference: https://help.uber.com/en/riders/article/node-title?nodeId=12312768-6482-4969-8790-ff6efcf8c93f and https://www.uber.com/tw/en/ride/how-it-works/tips/ . Used the optional post-trip choice, preset amounts and custom-amount pattern; this is an independently designed concept receipt, not a reproduction of a particular Uber screen.
changes: Introduced billing vocabulary in scroll order and removed the duplicated calculator/payment surface.
Placed usage, rounding, optional donation and final total in one receipt. Donation choices preserve usage; custom entry preserves the selected amount.
Used readable relative type, quieter supporting notes and reflowing layouts; separated the custom donation control from preset dollar buttons.
Explained economics terms before controls/results; clarified the local permission preview and source/download labels.
Fixed scenario persistence for visitors who naturally scroll into the bill. Shared calculations and reset remain connected to the same formula.
Kept exact pricing, source evidence, philosophical wording, blue palette, official font files and pet declarations intact.

cases.title: First-reader orientation
cases.action: Read the homepage, overview and billing entry in viewport-sized steps at 390 CSS pixels.
cases.expected: Purpose and billing sequence are introduced before the controls.
cases.actual: The page identifies an independent ChatGPT concept, explains membership plus usage, then rounding and optional donation. This is an editorial review, not a novice-user study.

cases.title: One receipt, one payment sequence
cases.action: Inspect the final billing panel on desktop and mobile.
cases.expected: One receipt contains membership, editable usage, subtotal, adjustment, donation and final bill.
cases.actual: The duplicate calculator summary and quick-donation preset were removed. Formula, charitable-path and origin details follow the receipt.

cases.title: All preset donations
cases.action: Set usage to 86.40; choose $0, $1, $5 and $10.
cases.actual: All four final totals matched; the $0 option explicitly means no donation.

cases.title: Donation preserves a nondefault usage amount
cases.action: Set usage to 585.25 and choose a $5 donation.
cases.expected: Subtotal 605.25, rounded bill 600.00, final 605.00; usage remains 585.25.
cases.actual: Matched in desktop interaction and 320-pixel mobile with 200% root text.

cases.title: Custom donation preserves the selected amount
cases.action: Choose $5, open Enter another amount, then type 7.23 at usage 585.25.
cases.expected: Opening custom preserves 5; final becomes 607.23 without resetting usage.
cases.actual: Observed 5 in the custom field, then 607.23 final and unchanged 585.25 usage. The custom control spans its own row.

cases.title: Formula and receipt share one scenario
cases.action: With a $10 donation, select the 525.17 subtotal example.
cases.expected: Usage becomes 505.17, settled bill 550, final 560 in both views.
cases.actual: Receipt and drawer both displayed 560.00. The donation was retained.

cases.title: Shared calculation restores the same values
cases.action: Copy the calculation link and navigate to the clipboard URL.
cases.expected: Restore usage, donation and expanded formula.
cases.actual: Restored /#pricing-formula?v=2&use=505.17&gift=10&formula=1; both totals were 560.00.

cases.title: Reset has a complete and predictable result
cases.action: Activate Reset example bill from a shared nondefault calculation.
cases.expected: Restore usage 86.40, no donation, final 100 and collapsed formula.
cases.actual: Observed 86.4 input, 100.00 final, and no open attribute on the formula drawer.

cases.title: Natural-scroll edits survive refresh
cases.action: Enter from the root without a hash, edit usage to 585.25, choose 5, and reload.
cases.expected: The URL records the scenario and reload preserves it.
cases.actual: URL became #billing?v=2&use=585.25&gift=5&formula=0; reload restored 585.25 and final 605.00. This corrects an observed pre-fix omission for natural scrolling.

cases.title: Pointer and keyboard controls
cases.action: Drag the usage range with a pointer; use Home and ArrowRight; operate donation buttons and tabs by keyboard.
cases.expected: Inputs update and navigation remains operable without a pointer.
cases.actual: Home plus ArrowRight produced 0.01 usage and a 20.00 pre-donation bill. Enter activated donation options; ArrowRight changed desktop tabs. Large-text permission preview also worked with Space and Enter. A native pointer drag to the range midpoint produced 500 usage, 520 subtotal and 500 rounded bill.

cases.title: Economics definitions and visible response
cases.action: Open economics directly; inspect definitions and change monthly AI usage to 120.75.
cases.expected: Units and contribution are explained before results; revenue updates.
cases.actual: Modeled units precede inputs; financial contribution is distinguished from donations. Revenue changed to 130.75 on desktop and mobile. The comparison explains demand served and tier settlement before the table/cards.

cases.title: Permission preview is contextual and local
cases.action: Read the permission introduction; select Projects & GitHub and preview.
cases.expected: Explain the choice before selection; report only selected evidence without implying access was granted.
cases.actual: The result said 1 evidence category selected, named Projects & GitHub, and reiterated that nothing was connected or sent. Verified with keyboard at 200% mobile text.

cases.title: Research access and filtering
cases.action: Open research, inspect source/download labels, and search for loyalty.
cases.expected: Sources and file formats are named; relevant chapters remain.
cases.actual: The filter returned thesis, loyalty, economics, philosophy, timeline and open-questions chapters. Source labels identify Pasta Board and file formats.

cases.title: Desktop layout review
cases.action: Inspect homepage, receipt, economics, relationship and research at 1348 CSS-pixel content width.
cases.expected: Hierarchy and interactions remain clear across desktop panels.
cases.actual: Screenshots reviewed for each panel. The receipt remains beside its short introduction; the formula expands below. Tab and calculator interactions were exercised.

cases.title: Narrow default layout
cases.action: Inspect billing and adjacent panels at 390 and 320 CSS pixels.
cases.expected: No whole-page horizontal overflow; controls and disclosures remain usable.
cases.actual: Observed document widths equal content widths. Receipt precedes supporting drawers. The donation custom control has its own row; preset controls have at least 48-pixel height at default text size.

cases.title: 200% text enlargement
cases.action: Set root text to 32px in a temporary same-origin test frame at 320, 390 and desktop widths.
cases.expected: Text scales, controls wrap and the document does not widen.
cases.actual: Billing reflowed without whole-page overflow at 320 and 390; desktop text enlargement also reflowed. Economics, relationship and research were checked at 320; corrected formula-grid and loyalty-comparison overflow. Donation arithmetic and permission keyboard controls worked while enlarged.

cases.title: Zoom-equivalent reflow
cases.action: Render a 659 CSS-pixel content viewport at 2x visual scale in the test frame.
cases.expected: The desktop-sized display reflows to a narrow single-column layout.
cases.actual: Observed 659 scroll width matching 659 client width. This is a layout simulation only, not native browser zoom or a scaled-frame pointer certification.

cases.title: Primary and secondary type hierarchy
cases.action: Inspect computed type and donation button dimensions.
cases.expected: Primary mobile prose and inputs remain readable; supporting notes are smaller; custom amount is not squeezed into an equal amount pill.
cases.actual: Primary prose and inputs are 16px at default size; notes are 13px. Type uses rem units. Donation choices use 48px minimum targets and adapt to two columns when enlarged; custom amount is full width.
